# hana

41, Galway. Walks the long way to everything, lifts twice a week in a room
above a hardware shop, and keeps the record herself on her phone.

Six months of record, and one thing before it: a fitness band she wore
through the previous summer and autumn, replaced when the strap perished. The
band sat in a drawer until the end of June, when she plugged it in one evening
and pulled seven months of step counts off it.

## Why she exists

Every other record in this corpus has channels that simply are. They begin at
the first row and run to the last, so nothing in the fixtures ever had to say
what it MEANS when a channel stops. Hers has four, and three of them are quiet
at the horizon:

- the phone app, alive and logging most evenings;
- the club treadmill, which stopped in February when the membership lapsed,
  and which she wrote down as finished;
- the chest strap, which stopped in April and which she did not write down;
- the band, which was never a channel at all - one evening's import of
  something already over.

Only one of those four is a question, and telling them apart is the entire
axis of this persona.
